description_zh: 没有已知塞克斯图斯·庞培撰写的文学或哲学著作传世。其政治宣传主要通过硬币图像（Pius称号、海神尼普顿图像）传播。如有铭文或书信残篇，需更新。
description_en: No literary or philosophical works by Sextus Pompey are known to survive. His political propaganda was communicated primarily through coin imagery (the Pius title, Neptune iconography). Any inscriptions or letter fragments would require updating.
review_note: 未发现传世著作。硬币是其自我呈现的主要媒介。
